ValidationRule.description: Enrollment Fee Verified Needed before moving Trust Status to Approved or Future Funded
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(Trust_Status__c), OR(TEXT(Trust_Status__c) = "Active", TEXT(Trust_Status__c) = "Future Funded"), Enrollment_Fee_Verified__c = FALSE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please check Enrollment Fee Verified before moving Trust Status to Active or Future Funded
